scope: Independent saved-table arithmetic and ranking audit after all four new main analyses completed. The four new units and original-plus-new five units are reported separately. No CKA/activation recomputation, training, forward pass, process signal, frozen code edit or paper edit.
interpretation: All signs use the original exact-zero rule. No new practical-effect threshold, p-value or independent-binomial model is introduced.
The 32 coupled conditions share tasks, models, data and initial weights within a unit. Repetitions are complete units; condition counts are descriptive.
The historical unit was already observed; the new-four analysis is distinguished from the all-five descriptive cohort.
Raw Comparison B initial candidate scores are equal within each fixed condition. Candidate-specific answer stratification does not inherit that zero contrast.
All direction disagreements and unrounded continuous values are retained; endpoint completion does not imply every source task was fully mastered.
